parameter.name: oidc_force_interaction_code
parameter.description: Require native Interaction Code (IDX) authentication for the configured OIDC issuer. When true, Himmelblau never falls back to device authorization or the browser orchestrator. The server must implement the compatible IDX protocol, and the configured public client must permit Interaction Code. .PP When false, Himmelblau probes likely compatible providers (including Okta) and issuers without device authorization, then falls back quietly when native authentication is unavailable. Selection is fixed until daemon restart; selection during a network outage is deferred until connectivity returns.
parameter.conf_description: Require native OIDC Interaction Code authentication.
